description: After reviewing an instrumentation gap and preferably previewing it, apply the chosen library extension. Installs the package and updates the OTel hook, package.json, and lockfile; repeating the same extension is a no-op.

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

registration_snippet.description: The JS/TS snippet to splice into the instrumentations array, e.g. "instrumentations.push(new PrismaInstrumentation())"

version.description: Semver range for the instrumentation package, e.g. "^6.0.0"

name: neat_apply_extension
